hair and body
div.p: ABJ AIBAOJI brings the complete daily ritual to Cambodia — a blue-and-white Skin Care Series for your face and a Wash Care Series for hair and body.

img.alt: ABJ AIBAOJI Mild Non-irritating Makeup Remover bottle

div.p: Everyday care shouldn't be complicated or harsh. Too many products strip moisture, irritate the skin barrier, or ask for a 12-step routine that no one keeps up with in 35° heat.

AIBAOJI was built around one idea: gentle, matched products that simply work together. Cleanse without taking away water, brighten with proven niacinamide, protect with SPF 50+, and finish with nourishing hair and body care. Today the ritual is loved by more than 2,000 customers across Cambodia.
Mild, non-irritating formulas — soothing gentle skin care that never damages the skin barrier.
Niacinamide brightening, SPF 50+ photoaging protection and white truffle deep moisture — ingredients chosen to do something.
Skin Care Series and Wash Care Series designed as one system — from the first cleanse to soft, fragrant skin and hair.
Cleanse · brighten · protect · nourish — every step, softly.
